# Electron Project

This is an Electron desktop application.

## Architecture

- **Main process:** `electron/main.js` (Node.js/Electron APIs). Owns the window,
  file dialogs, file watchers, search index, PDF/HTML export and file associations.
- **Preload:** `electron/preload.js` exposes a safe `window.markdownReader` bridge
  (`invoke` + `on`) through `contextBridge`.
- **Renderer:** React app in `src/mainview`, built by Vite into `dist/`.
  It talks to the main process through `src/mainview/desktop.ts`.

## Quick Reference

- Create windows with `new BrowserWindow({ webPreferences: { preload } })`.
- Register request handlers with `ipcMain.handle(channel, handler)`.
- Call them from the renderer via `window.markdownReader.invoke(channel, params)`.
- Main-to-renderer events use `webContents.send(channel, payload)` and are
  subscribed with `window.markdownReader.on(channel, listener)`.
- Only channels listed in `electron/preload.js` are allowed.
- Context isolation is enabled; Node integration is disabled in the renderer.

## Auto-update

- Uses `electron-updater` with the GitHub provider configured in the
  `build.publish` field of `package.json`.
- Disabled in development (`app.isPackaged === false`).
- IPC: `update:check`, `update:download`, `update:install` (requests) and
  `update:status` (event with `state: checking | available | not-available |
  downloading | downloaded | error`).
- electron-builder writes `app-update.yml` into the app resources and generates
  `latest*.yml` metadata; the release workflow must upload those `.yml` files
  (and `.blockmap`) next to the installers.
- macOS auto-update requires a signed/notarized build.

## Scripts

- `bun run dev` - Vite dev server + Electron with HMR.
- `bun run build` - Build the renderer with Vite.
- `bun run dist` - Package the app with electron-builder (output in `artifacts/`).

## Documentation

Electron API reference: https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/
electron-builder: https://www.electron.build/
electron-updater: https://www.electron.build/auto-update
